assertions.assertion: Discover, confirm, and execute each resolve C05, enforce C06 TOOL_CALL, then resolve C05 again before Tenant admission.
assertions.evidence: Node behavior and C06 integration tests

assertions.assertion: Only three fixed read-only Synthetic operations and strict parameter schemas are accepted.
assertions.evidence: Catalog contract and negative parameter tests

assertions.assertion: Execute binds the immutable parameter, catalog, adapter, Tenant, identity, confirmation, and idempotency hashes.
assertions.evidence: Tamper, expiry, replay, and authority-change tests

assertions.assertion: A short-lived single-call Synthetic capability is passed only as a private Adapter argument and is absent from responses, errors, receipts, audit, and snapshots.
The C0 Adapter performs no network request or real external side effect.
assertions.evidence: Adapter counters, closed problem codes, and static scans

assertions.assertion: Metadata-only immutable audit intents retry the same intent after a lost publisher ACK.
Every C16 table has a Tenant key with FORCE RLS and separate owner, runtime, worker, audit-worker, and recovery roles.
assertions.evidence: PostgreSQL 17 role, RLS, mixed-pool, and scope-cleanup tests

assertions.assertion: A fresh PostgreSQL system can restore pending and completed C16 state and resume audit publication.
assertions.evidence: pg_dump and pg_restore test on a different system identifier
